text: Welcome to Blackthorn. Mind the fire, mind your purse, and don't touch my tents.
Rook Varga. You've heard of me, I'm sure. Everything you've heard is true, especially the bad bits.
Sit by the fire, captain. Tell me something interesting or buy me a drink. Ideally both.
Always welcome by my fire, friend. Harrow's still fuming. It's the best thing I've ever bought.
Harrow's lapdog. Drink your rum and keep your hands where I can see them.
...you're still alive. Of course you are.
My partner in the Accord! Found any more shiny rocks?
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: How did you become a captain?

text: Blackthorn's mine. A palisade, a fire, a fence called Tilda who buys anything, and a card table for when the rum runs low.
The Navy knows where it is. They just don't like how many guns I've got pointed at the only beach.
Mutinied off a Tidewatch frigate at sixteen. Took the purser's strongbox and the cook. Kept the cook. Best decision I ever made.
Nobody makes you a captain, captain. You just start giving orders and see who listens.
Every free captain under one flag. No Navy, no Court, no Brethren votes taking a week. Just us, and whatever's past the edge of the chart.
Trust me. You can always trust Rook Varga. Ask anyone. Well. Ask anyone still around.
The Accord was always going to be mine. You were useful. Nothing personal.
